title: DoubleTree by Hilton Goa - Panaji
description: Tucked between lush forest and the calming waters of the Mandovi River, we’re located 10 minutes from the UNESCO World Heritage Site at Old Goa. Goa's capital city Panaji and Miramar Beach are both 15 minutes away, as is a choice of shopping, dining, and nightlife. Goa International Airport can be reached in 45 minutes.

title: Hilton Goa Resort
description: Our hilltop resort in Candolim, set on the Saipem hills, overlooks Goa’s greenery and the Nerul River. Enjoy four outdoor pools, a kids club, fitness centre, signature concierge experiences, and featured local Goan accents. Candolim Beach, Aguada Fort, the Museum of Goa, and major attractions are nearby. GOI and GOX airports are a 60-minute drive.

title: Baale Resort Goa an SLH Hotel
description: Baale Resort Goa, a Member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World, offers seven fully-serviced stylish villas with private pools, personal butler service, curated chef dinners and spa treatments within the privacy of your villa. Surrounded by tropical gardens, each villa blends Balinese design with Goan warmth, ideal for families or groups seeking privacy and comfort.

title: Hilton Garden Inn Goa Calangute
description: Find us off Candolim Road, less than a kilometer from the Candolim - Calangute - Baga beach belt. Valanka Shopping Mall, local markets, dining, and casinos are a two-minute drive. Sinquerim Fort and Fort Aguada are less than six km away. Enjoy our rooftop infinity pool and deck, scenic views, wellness spa, kids’ play area, and nearby beach access.

title: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Goa - Arpora - Baga
description: Set on two acres, we offer access to the coast and North Goa nightlife. Anjuna, Baga, and Calangute beaches are 10 minutes away. Vagator-Ozran and Assagao nightlife is within 5 kilometers and Morjim-Ashvem beaches are 13 km away. GOI and GOX Airports are an hour from us. Enjoy spacious rooms with patios or balconies overlooking the pool or garden.
